_comment: Vol 23 (River West / West Town, ~1-1100 N, 1100-2000 W) -> modern renames. VOLUME-SCOPED. Source: 'Chicago Streets', William Martin 1948 (CHM street-name-changes list, http://chsmedia.org/househistory/nameChanges/start.pdf, accessed 2026-07-25). Each entry was spot-checked against the sheets; CORNELL->CHESTNUT (not Iowa) disambiguated on-sheet. PARK here is the E-W Park Ave -> Maypole stretch; the same retired name maps differently in other volumes.
